Maya_CSM: Quick idea for OrionLedger renewal: run a tight perf pilot - int8 quant + region-aware warm routing. Goal: p50 ~ -20% and ~15% token savings. Renewal convo in 6 weeks. Thoughts?
Owen_SE: Good fit. Theyare about fidelity. Recommend 6% canary, auto-fallback to `orion-v2-fp16`, blind eval on 400 prompts. Need seq-dist and p95 baseline.
Kai_RE: Baseline slice: median_seq=125, p75=240, p95 spikes at 13:00 UTC. Baseline p50=210ms, p95=640ms. Sample: ```json
{"13":{"reqs":1800,"p50":290,"p95":660}}```
Owen_SE: Canary draft config:
```yaml
traffic_split: 0.06
model_variant: orion-v2-int8
fallback: orion-v2-fp16
monitoring: [latency,error_rate,semantic_similarity]
collect_samples: true
abort_on_quality_delta_pct: 1.0
```
Maya_CSM: I'll get customer sign-off on sampled prompts and offer rollback SLA of 45m.
deploy_bot: Canary started orion-v2-int8 -> 6% traffic at 3301234570. Check canary/3301234567.
deploy_bot: Canary update: 30m in, p50 down 19%, p95 down 12%, error rate stable. No regression alerts.
Owen_SE: Uploading samples to shared drive and queuing blind eval. Will abort if eval >1% quality delta.
Maya_CSM: Great. If clean for 24h we'll include this as a renewal optimization in the proposal.
__notes: Concise CS+Eng coordination thread for a small int8 quantization + routing canary for a renewal account. Includes brief metrics, YAML/JSON snippets, and deploy bot updates.
